card.name: The word every after repeated
card.fires_on: The word "every" right after "repeated" in dosing directions. It is followed by an interval such as 4 weeks, 21 days or 2 to 3 minutes.

modes.label: Repeat interval
modes.description: "every" after "repeated" gives the spacing for repeating a dose or treatment cycle.
